issues.description: Switching Promise.all to Promise.allSettled changes the result shape: each entry is {status, value} on success or {status, reason} on rejection. The code reads `r.value.name` without checking `r.status`, so any rejected fetch yields `r.value === undefined` and throws a TypeError on `.name` — and even when it doesn't throw, failures are silently swallowed instead of propagating. The 'more robust' change is strictly worse than the original fail-fast.
